examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A header row divided from the body by one hairline. The header is a `SectionTitle`, so the module never re-implements that anatomy.

examples.name: Kinds
examples.summary: The three header layouts, stacked — they differ only in where the copy sits.

examples.name: Divided
examples.summary: Two modules, the first undivided. A shared edge is invisible on a single module — the stack is what proves the rule is drawn once.

examples.name: Padded
examples.summary: With `padded` off the body runs edge to edge, for a grid that owns its cell padding.
